title: Deduplicate CSS for components used both statically and with client:only on the same page
body:
## Changes

- A React (or other framework) component whose CSS module was already included in the page's SSR/prerender stylesheet no longer gets that CSS added a second time when the same component also appears as `client:only` on the same page. Previously, the client build's `getParentClientOnlys` block unconditionally added the component's CSS asset to the page regardless of what the SSR build had already bundled, producing two linked stylesheets with overlapping rules.
- The fix introduces a closure variable (`ssrPageCssModuleIds`) in `plugin-css.ts` that records which CSS module IDs were assigned to each page during SSR/prerender. The `client:only` path skips adding a CSS module to a page that already has it. Pages where the component appears *only* as `client:only` are unaffected and still receive the CSS.

## Testing

- Added a new fixture page (`css-modules-static-and-client-only.astro`) to the `astro-client-only` test fixture and corresponding assertions in `packages/astro/test/astro-client-only.test.ts` covering: server output with `inlineStylesheets: 'never'` (one stylesheet, not two), and a `client:only`-only page (CSS still present).

## Docs

- No docs update needed; this is a build-output correctness fix with no user-facing API changes.

Closes #18123

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'astro': patch
+---
+
+Fixes duplicate CSS in production builds when a component is both server-rendered and used with `client:only` on the same page

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+import UsingCSSModules from '../components/UsingCSSModules.jsx';
+---
+<html>
+	<head>
+		<title>Using CSS modules statically and client:only</title>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<UsingCSSModules />
+		<UsingCSSModules client:only="react" />
+	</body>
+</html>
